spec: §2 + §8.1 + §14 — SLIP-0010 pinned-path vectors m/111'/0'/0' (Ed25519 signing seed) and m/111'/0'/1' (X25519 scalar), with the BIP-39 seed derivation they sit on
description: Project-path vectors generated at build and frozen (section 14). For each canonical mnemonic: BIP-39 entropy -> words (English), PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 seed with the EMPTY passphrase (v1 has no passphrase, section 8.1), then SLIP-0010 hardened-only derivation at the two pinned paths. The 12-word values match the module-printed vectors of slip0010.rs and bip39.rs; the independent Python cross-check (test-vectors/crosscheck.py) re-derives all of them from scratch. The ECDH scalar is RAW (clamped at point of use).
provenance: 12-word: harvested from slip0010.rs::slip0010_project_path_vectors (--nocapture). 24-word: generated through the public API for this freeze and cross-checked by crosscheck.py.
